lego - marvel captain america vs. thanos.description: The LEGO Marvel Captain America vs. Thanos (76319) building set launches little builders 4 years old and up straight into Marvel's most epic showdown! Young Marvel fans can join Captain America as he faces off against the mighty Thanos in a cosmic battle of good vs. evil. Kids can build Captain America's iconic shield-equipped Quinjet with dual shooters and an opening cockpit, Thanos's menacing Infinity Gauntlet ship with moving fingers and missile launcher, and a small bonus build featuring a cosmic stone. Young Marvel fans will love swooping in with the Quinjet to help Captain America save the day or posing the Gauntlet ship for defensive maneuvers. LEGO | Marvel minifigures of Thanos and Captain America can be placed in each ship's cockpit for endless pretend play battles as children recreate movie scenes or invent new adventures. This high-quality construction toy makes a perfect gift for preschoolers who love building blocks and creative play starring their favorite super heroes and villains. Parents can enjoy building together with little ones as they use the large Starter Brick and easy-to-follow pictorial instructions, which make construction quick and rewarding. Each bag contains bricks, including a large Starter Brick for a fast-to-build model, and a character so play can begin quickly. Contains 107 pieces.
